title: SunRey Sovereign Oracle Network and Verified Economic Fact Protocol
notes: IMPLEMENTED at packages/sunrey-chain (TypeScript oracle engine) and packages/sunrey-chain/rust/crates/oracle (local-node oracle module). Signed OracleObservation transactions. Deterministic multi-source aggregation. VerifiedEconomicFact is not money and does not authorize MoonRey issuance. Consensus never calls HTTP or external APIs. Chunk 42 general resource metering is not a standalone capability on main; oracle submissions consume the integer resource-meter port in this owner. evaluateChunkRequirements returns mustStop: false. Do not create packages/oracle, packages/sunrey-oracle, or packages/oracle-network.
